entities.summary: Jeffrey Scott Grob is an American Catholic prelate who is currently serving as Archbishop of Milwaukee. Before his appointment as Archbishop of Milwaukee he previously served as an auxiliary bishop for the Archdiocese of Chicago from 2020 to 2025.
